name: Wooting keyboards (legacy firmware)
description: Per-key lighting of the Wooting One and Wooting Two with legacy (V1) firmware on the Atmel vendor id 0x03EB (usage page 0x1337). Same code as plugins/wooting (a plugin has one vendor id). Adapted from OpenRGB's WootingKeyboardController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. Sends only the colour-init, raw-colour and (at shutdown) reset-all colour commands; nothing is stored. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/wooting.md.
